Name: Vegan Food Alternatives
Author: Daenvil
Description:
[size=5][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b]
[/size]
You need to install the following mods:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿
[/list][left]

[b][u][size=5]Features[/size][/u][/b][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XmQRIcG.png[/img]

New artisan goods, as well as new ways of obtaining some vanilla items:

[list]
[*]Make [b]Plant Milk[/b] in a keg, using ingredients such as coconuts, hazelnuts, beans, etc.
[*]Convert plant milk into [b]Tofu[/b] using a preserves jar. [b]Smoke tofu[/b] in a (fish) smoker.
[*]Convert plant milk into [b]Vegan Cheese[/b] using a cheese press. Age it in casks.
[*]Convert plant milk into [b]Mayonnaise [/b]using a mayonnaise machine.
[*]Make [b]Starch[/b] in a preserves jar, using ingredients such as corn, potatoes, yams, etc. [b]Starch can be used instead of eggs in all recipes.[/b]
[*]Make [b]Flower Syrup [/b](vegan honey) in a preserves jar by putting two of any flower into it.
[*]Make [b]Vegan Mead[/b] in a keg, using either flower or maple syrup
[/list]
For a full list of possible ingredients, as well as details of time taken and output price, please consult the "readme" file inside the mod files.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lLLmWma.png[/img]

This mod adds [b]10 new cooking recipes[/b], as well as adapting some of the non-vegan vanilla recipes so they also accept vegan ingredients.

The main purpose of these is to offer vegan alternatives to every non-vegan dish that provides some kind of relevant buff, plus adding a couple more recipes just for fun.

In case you are wondering why I included recipes that require or buff fishing, that's because I'm planning another mod for a vegan fishing alternative.

[b][u][size=3]New Recipes:[/size][/u][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R0GiWvu.png[/img]

[b][u][size=3]Modified Vanilla Recipes:[/size][/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Any recipe that uses milk, cheese, egg, mayo, or honey as ingredients will also accept the vegan alternatives for those ingredients.
[*][b]Dish O' The Sea[/b] accepts seaweed in place of sardines.
[*][b]Lucky Lunch[/b] accepts cave jelly in place of sea cucumber.
[*][b]Tom Kha Soup[/b] accepts tofu in place of shrimp.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6i3GZEw.png[/img]

You can set these options either in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (recommended) or by manually editing the "config.json" file which is automatically created in the mod folder when running it for the first time.

[list]
[*][b]Edit vanilla items[/b] (default: true): if enabled, some vanilla items will be renamed to be more accurate (e.g. 'Milk' will be renamed to 'Cow Milk'), some machine descriptions will be updated to inform of their new uses (e.g. preserves jar making tofu), and some items will be retextured (e.g. the smoker won't have a fish on it). These changes are only cosmetic and don't affect gameplay.
[*][b]Override Cornucopia items[/b] (default: false, requires having [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia [/url]﻿mods installed): if enabled, some items added by Cornucopia won't be obtainable, such as coconut milk or nut cheese, in order to avoid duplicated items that are already added by this mod. [i]For example, putting soybeans into a keg with this option disabled will result in Cornucopia's soy milk, while doing it with this option enabled will result in this mod's soy milk.[/i]
[/list]

[b][u][size=4]Complementary Mods[/size][/u][/b]

Some mods that may go nicely along with this one:

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] adds many new crops that are usable by this mod to make milk, starch, etc.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url] adds new machines, including ways to make plant-based yogurt and butter.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34782]Vegan in the Valley[/url] adds some more vegan dishes.
